format_note: Single-file mock Outlook export. Messages are grouped by conversation and also flattened for ingestion.

messages.subject: August retail roster cutoff exception
messages.body: We have a late retail roster correction for August. The store export failed this morning and 42 employees are affected. Can SD Worx accept a corrected file tomorrow by 12:00? This concerns Belgian retail stores only, not corporate or Network Operations.

attachments.name: PXS_retail_roster_delta_august.xlsx
attachments.content_summary: Synthetic roster correction file, 42 employees, Belgian retail stores.

messages.subject: RE: August retail roster cutoff exception
messages.body: The official standing exception is D-4 at 12:00 for retail corrections. Tomorrow noon is D-3 for August, so we need to treat this as a one-off exception. Jonas, can you confirm capacity before we reply with acceptance?

messages.subject: RE: August retail roster cutoff exception
messages.body: Accepted for August only. Please send the corrected file by 2026-08-19 12:00 and mark it as final. This does not change the standing D-4 retail cutoff in the calendar.

messages.subject: May payroll payment approval owner
messages.body: Starting with the May 2026 payroll, Finance Operations is the final approver for the SEPA payment total. HR Shared Services remains responsible for HR content validation, but payment release approval must come from Finance Operations.

messages.subject: RE: May payroll payment approval owner
messages.body: Confirmed. We will treat Finance Operations approval as mandatory before SEPA release. I will ask our team to update the SharePoint procedure because it still lists HR Shared Services as final approver.

attachments.name: Payment Approval and SEPA Release Procedure.md

messages.subject: RE: May payroll payment approval owner
messages.body: Agreed from HR side. HR Shared Services validates the HR input and payroll exceptions, but Finance Operations gives the release approval for the payment file.

threads.subject: Field technician night intervention code from September

messages.subject: Field technician night intervention code from September
messages.body: Can you confirm whether the new night intervention code 5413 is effective for Belgium from the September 2026 payroll, or whether we should continue with the current matrix until a signed change request is available?

attachments.name: Field Technician Standby and Intervention Allowance Matrix.md

messages.subject: RE: Field technician night intervention code from September
messages.body: The July-August use was a pilot only. Please configure code 5413 for Belgian night intervention premiums from the September 2026 payroll, after the signed change request is uploaded. Do not apply it to Luxembourg entities.

messages.subject: RE: Field technician night intervention code from September
messages.body: Understood. We will wait for the signed change request before changing configuration. I will flag SP-PROX-004 as under review because the current matrix still points to code 5419 for night intervention.

threads.subject: September payslip correction - weekend premium missing

messages.subject: September payslip correction - weekend premium missing
messages.body: We have 14 employees whose weekend intervention premium is missing from the September payslip. The approximate net impact is between EUR 72 and EUR 118 per employee. Can this be corrected off-cycle?

attachments.name: missing_weekend_premium_cases_sep.xlsx
attachments.content_summary: Synthetic list of 14 affected employee IDs with net impact estimate.

messages.subject: RE: September payslip correction - weekend premium missing
messages.body: We can prepare an off-cycle correction for employees with net impact above EUR 100 and review the EUR 72-EUR 99 cases separately. The manual says EUR 100; the lower threshold in old handover notes is precedent only, not policy.

threads.subject: September HRIS import rejected rows - cost center mapping

messages.subject: September HRIS import rejected rows - cost center mapping
messages.body: The September HRIS import rejected 37 rows because cost center PXS-RET-OLD is not mapped in the current interface table. The rows appear to be retail employees. Please confirm whether we should map PXS-RET-OLD to PXS-RET-BE for this payroll month.

attachments.name: import_rejection_report_2026-09-19.csv
attachments.content_summary: Synthetic validation export with rejected cost center values.

messages.subject: RE: September HRIS import rejected rows - cost center mapping
messages.body: Confirmed. For September payroll only, map PXS-RET-OLD to PXS-RET-BE for the 37 rejected rows. We will clean the HRIS source before October.

threads.subject: Year-end payroll and tax preparation milestones

messages.subject: Year-end payroll and tax preparation milestones
messages.body: To prepare year-end, we propose validating benefit corrections by 2026-11-30, exceptional taxable benefits by 2026-12-07, and Belcotax control totals in January. Please confirm the Proximus owner for year-end tax review.

messages.subject: RE: Year-end payroll and tax preparation milestones
messages.body: Confirmed. HR Shared Services owns benefit correction completeness. Finance Operations owns payment and accounting control totals. Please include Pieter on the January Belcotax control review.
